title: You need less than you think
coreMove: Challenge every claimed prerequisite before buying it. Start with a smaller team, a shorter cut, and cheaper space, then add only the resource a proven constraint demands.

exampleSpecs.stakes: burning runway on headcount before validation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: shrink an imagined ten-person plan to the two people who can run the first test

exampleSpecs.stakes: spending four extra months before learning if the idea works
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: find the two-month cut hidden inside a six-month plan

exampleSpecs.stakes: a twelve-month kitchen lease before a single sale
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: swap a leased commercial kitchen for a home oven and rented shelf

exampleSpecs.stakes: monthly warehouse rent against unproven demand
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: stop early inventory commitments from creating obligations before value

exampleSpecs.stakes: starving a real bottleneck in the name of staying lean
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: add a resource only after a constraint demonstrates itself

exampleSpecs.stakes: headcount creep that demands more infrastructure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: treat subtraction as the default before adding weight, in the 37signals mode
